summary: RTH→AH Volume Handoff: when direct ahVolume is unavailable, TAG500 can derive After-Hours Volume Participation and Volume Takeover from the same-day central R15 baseline versus current total volume, but only when extended-hours volume fields are confirmed moving and non-frozen.
